toegepas.voor: Julle praat al hoe harder en niemand
toegepas.na: Julle praat al hoe harder, en niemand
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins 'Julle praat al hoe harder' and 'niemand wil toegee nie', each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Plain punctuation fix against the AWS 2017; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: So beskerm jy jouself en kry jy hulp vir die ander ook.
toegepas.na: So beskerm jy jouself, en kry jy ook hulp vir die ander.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Sentence-final 'ook' is unnatural word order, and the AWS comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('beskerm jy', 'kry jy'), and the trailing 'ook' reads loosely.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and 'kry jy ook hulp vir die ander' is the natural order with the same meaning; this is a consequence, not an instruction.

toegepas.voor: Soms kom twee maats nie alleen uit nie
toegepas.na: Soms kom twee maats nie op hul eie reg nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'nie alleen uitkom nie' is unclear ('uitkom' suggests getting out or getting along); 'nie op hul eie regkom nie' says they cannot manage it themselves.
toegepas.fout: 'nie alleen uitkom nie' is vague and can be read as 'not get along' rather than 'not manage it by themselves'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'nie op hul eie reg nie' (separable 'regkom') says plainly that they cannot sort it out alone, which is the meaning intended.

toegepas.voor: Daarna vra hy elkeen wat hy nodig het.
toegepas.na: Daarna vra hy vir elkeen wat dié nodig het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second 'hy' could refer to the mediator himself; 'dié' points clearly to each of the two.
toegepas.fout: The second 'hy' can point to the mediator as well as to 'elkeen'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dié' removes the ambiguity, and 'vra vir elkeen' keeps the same who-asks-whom.

toegepas.blok: Vyf vaardighede wat die vrede bewaar
toegepas.na: en hulle mag anders dink as jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: The ellipsis is hard to follow for a Grade 6 reader; repeating the verb makes the reciprocity clear without changing the meaning.
toegepas.fout: The elliptical 'en hulle as jy' makes a reader stop to supply the verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Repeating 'mag anders dink' makes the reciprocity clear at once with no change of meaning, within the list allowance.

toegepas.blok: Vyf vaardighede wat die vrede bewaar
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'name noem' is a calque of 'call names' and in Afrikaans means 'mention names'; 'spotname gee' is the Afrikaans for name-calling.
toegepas.fout: 'name noem' is a calque of 'call names' and in Afrikaans reads as 'mention names'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'spotname gee' is the Afrikaans idiom for name-calling and keeps the meaning beside 'skel'.

toegepas.voor: beteken jy weet jou mening en gevoelens tel
toegepas.na: beteken dat jy weet jou mening en jou gevoelens tel
toegepas.rede_vinder: Adding 'dat' and the second 'jou' (both allowed by the protected entry) makes the run-together clause easier to read; 'gevoelens tel' stays.
toegepas.fout: 'beteken jy weet jou mening en gevoelens tel' runs two dependent clauses together without a conjunction and is hard to read first time.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'dat' and the second 'jou' smooths the sentence, both are allowed by the protected entry, and 'gevoelens tel' stays.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'n volgende een' is stiff; 'n ander een' is the natural phrase with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n volgende een' is acceptable Afrikaans and carries the sense of moving on to the next adult; in a safety instruction a lateral swap is not worth making.

laat_vaar.blok: Vyf vaardighede wat die vrede bewaar
laat_vaar.voor: Jy spot nie met 'n ander mening nie.
laat_vaar.na: Jy spot nie met iemand anders se mening nie.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: ''n ander mening' reads as 'a different opinion' in the abstract; the point is another person's opinion.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n ander mening' means a differing opinion, which is exactly the point after 'jy mag anders dink'; 'iemand anders se mening' narrows it to whose opinion it is.

vlae.blok: Wat 'n tussenganger doen; Vyf vaardighede wat die vrede bewaar
vlae.teks: Dan sê hy terug wat hy gehoor het / sê terug wat jy gehoor het
vlae.rede: 'terugsê' commonly means to talk back or retort in Afrikaans (the protected notes themselves use 'iets terugsê' that way), so the listening technique may be misread; a fix such as 'herhaal' or 'sê in jou eie woorde' would have to be made in both places at once and may shift the technique, so it is left to a person or the writer.

vlae.blok: Wanneer 'n kind nie tussenganger is nie
vlae.teks: Wanneer 'n kind nie tussenganger is nie
vlae.rede: The heading literally says 'when a child is not a mediator'; the block means 'when a child should not act as mediator' (e.g. 'Wanneer 'n kind nie tussenganger moet wees nie'). A heading cannot be changed by the script.

vlae.blok: Vyf vaardighede wat die vrede bewaar
vlae.rede: 'aksies' is an anglicism where Afrikaans says 'dade'; not changed because the label may follow the CAPS skill name, which only a person can confirm.
